helpers.name: remote-adb.sh
helpers.reason: ADB argv transport over an explicitly configured SSH host; not a standalone test and must never be invoked without the bounded device workflow context.

helpers.name: line02-android-accessibility-ui.sh
helpers.reason: Explicit enable/restore helper owned by isolated Android candidate setup and cleanup; requires ADB, RUNNER_TEMP and an action.

helpers.name: line02-android-cancel-candidate-setup.sh

helpers.name: remote-android-install.sh
helpers.reason: Transferred and run explicitly by the bounded Android E2E job to install its isolated APK; never a no-argument Ubuntu smoke.
